neighbours.label: the comma closing an 'if' condition that something failed a check (if the values do not match, an error...)
fire: Compare the two hashes; if the values do not match, the file is corrupt.
Check the totals; if the sums do not agree, a row is missing.
Read both signatures; if the names do not match, reject the form.
Check the receipts; if the amounts do not match, call the bank.
Compare the versions; if the numbers do not match, update the app.
Test both keys; if the codes do not match, access is denied.
Read the two logs; if the dates do not agree, restart the job.
Compare the copies; if the pages do not match, print them again.
quiet: Compare the two hashes and write down the file size.
Check the totals and add a row to the sheet.
Read both signatures and hand the form to the clerk.
Check the receipts and call the bank on Monday.
Compare the versions and read about the new app.
Test both keys and put them in the drawer.
Read the two logs and start the job at noon.
Compare the copies and print them again tomorrow.

notes: Card: ',' x11, ' them' x2, ' match', ' present', 'oring', ' doing', with health warnings and error checks. Probes: ',' after 'if the values do not match' 0.566; 'If you experience any one of them' 0.134; 'If either is present' 0.040. So my health reading failed, and I test the one that fired.
